remarks: Discover the potential of this charming four-bedroom Colonial located in one of Darien's most desirable neighborhoods. Set on just over an acre of beautifully flat, private land with a sparkling pool, this property offers endless possibilities. Built in 1953, the home exudes character and classic appeal, ready for a new owner to renovate, restore, or reimagine.  Within walking distance to local schools and just minutes from town, the train, this location is truly exceptional. Flag football on the lawn, basketball/pickleball on the sports court or a bbq pool party in the backyard; too many options for fun! Whether you choose to enhance the existing home with your own personal touches or build your dream residence from the ground up, this property presents a rare opportunity in a sought-after neighborhood. Dont miss this opportunity to have the most enjoyable time this summer in Darien.
